raw_response:
This is my main plot, so I want to give it a good chance. I usually try to get the FISP coupon when it comes around — last season I managed one bag of NPK and one bag of urea, and I save it mostly for this maize plot since it feeds the household. The plot is small so I don't need to hire people; my sister helps me with ridging and weeding. I intercrop pigeon pea with the maize like my mother taught me, and I add some kraal manure when I can get it from neighbors.
